mentions.name: Recall Audio
mentions.description: This is a multichannel audio recording app that continuously records into a configurable-length buffer, so if users realize after the fact that they wanted to record, they can recall the buffer and save everything, even if they forgot to hit record.
mentions.problem: When recording, people sometimes realize they needed to start recording 30 minutes earlier and lose that audio; there was no tool on the market for recalling audio from before the record button was pressed.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Recall Audio - A multichannel audio recording app that has your back, even if you forget to hit record.

Basically it continuously records into a buffer (length is configurable), and if you realize that you wanted to start recording 30 minutes ago you can recall the buffer and have everything saved.
